provenance: annex C16, 369.2-LARRY-ANNEX.md:137-141, names the labels; the definitions are written by the 369.25 planner from those names and Canon Part 9; the navigator may amend them
note: A vocabulary, not a ladder: the order below is the order a resolver tests the records in, never a ranking from uncertain to true. A label is shown only with its definition and the record it stands on.

labels.label: quote_matched
labels.definition: the quoted words were found verbatim in the named source; it says nothing about whether the source is right
labels.record: the source and the matched passage

labels.label: source_reports
labels.definition: a source says this and nobody here has checked it beyond reading it

labels.label: derived
labels.definition: reasoned here from other recorded claims; it is only as strong as those claims

labels.label: independently_checked
labels.definition: a second, independent source or a run result agrees
labels.record: the second source or the verification record

labels.label: canonically_confirmed
labels.definition: a person confirmed this claim in room.db (Canon Part 9)
labels.record: the confirmed node and who confirmed it
